headline: Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin halts deposits and withdrawals after about $40 million drained

scenes.vo: Brazil's largest crypto exchange just paused all deposits and withdrawals after a security breach. Here's what changed.
On Monday, Mercado Bitcoin said it found and contained a security incident. Security firms tracked forty to forty-six million dollars moving out across at least ten blockchains.
Here's why traders are watching it. The exchange says customers lost nothing, and Tether has already frozen more than four and a half million dollars of USDT tied to the attack.
The catch. Deposits and withdrawals are still frozen with no restart date. And nobody knows yet how the attacker got access to sign those transfers.
Here's what happens next. Watch for a restart date, a confirmed loss figure from the exchange, and whether more of the stolen funds get frozen.
